behaviors.description: Forward file arguments through a private document portal.
behaviors.preconditions: Private permission store/document portal executables and usable FUSE device.
behaviors.expected: Argument becomes document path; probe reads and writes host document; export disappears after portal restart.

behaviors.description: Replace application and runtime mounts and retain originals under parent mounts.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent reference checkouts with distinct added markers.
behaviors.expected: Replacement marker appears only under selected mount; original executable redirected; empty app-path omits app contents.

behaviors.description: Load NUL-separated environment from an inherited descriptor.
behaviors.preconditions: Controlled descriptor contains one environment assignment.
behaviors.expected: Probe reports exact value including equals sign and spaces.

behaviors.description: Report running instance ID through supplied descriptor.
behaviors.preconditions: Controlled writable descriptor and background hold probe.
behaviors.expected: Written decimal instance ID equals public ps row for app and launched PID.

behaviors.description: Filter controlled service through system-bus policies.
behaviors.preconditions: Private daemon address supplied as system bus, independent echo service and host client.
behaviors.expected: Default denial, run/stored system-talk reply, run/stored system-no-talk denial.

behaviors.description: Expose and revoke unfiltered controlled system bus.
behaviors.preconditions: Private daemon address supplied as system bus with echo service.
behaviors.expected: Socket grants permit otherwise denied service; run/stored socket revocation restores denial.

behaviors.description: Enable filtered session bus in restrictive mode and disable it explicitly.
behaviors.preconditions: Private echo service and host client.
behaviors.expected: Sandbox with session-bus and talk grant gets reply; no-session-bus removes connection.

behaviors.description: Persist USB queries, generic policy and accessibility name policy.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh overrides and controlled USB query file.
behaviors.expected: Exact public allow/hide query sets, policy additions/denial and accessibility own value.

behaviors.description: Report USB queries, generic policy and accessibility name policy.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed app and controlled USB query file.
behaviors.expected: Exact public sandbox-info USB query sets, effective policy and accessibility own value.

behaviors.description: Persist explicit conditional permission expressions.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh overrides and conditional permission support.
behaviors.expected: Exact true/false conditions on network, wayland, shm and devel in override show.

behaviors.description: Enforce conditional shared-memory access and report conditional expressions.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed app, controlled host /dev/shm marker and conditional permission support.
behaviors.expected: Marker unreadable by default, readable with shm:true and unreadable with shm:false; expression metadata also preserved.

behaviors.description: Revoke network granted in app metadata.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app metadata variant grants network; controlled loopback TCP listener.
behaviors.expected: Default connection accepted; run unshare makes probe connection fail.

behaviors.description: Select SDK for development mode.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent metadata variant names unavailable SDK and available runtime.
behaviors.expected: Normal run outputs A; devel fails identifying missing SDK.

behaviors.description: Restrict application permission with sandbox mode.
behaviors.preconditions: Stored filesystem grant exposes controlled host marker.
behaviors.expected: Normal run reads marker; sandbox mode denies probe read.

behaviors.description: Allow a controlled service through filtered session bus.
behaviors.preconditions: Private echo service and independent host dbus-send tool exposed through host-os files only.
behaviors.expected: Default destination denied; run and stored talk grants get replies; stored denial blocks again.

behaviors.description: Expose and revoke unfiltered private session bus socket.
behaviors.preconditions: Private echo service and independent host client.
behaviors.expected: Default filtered bus denies service; session-bus grants allow replies; nosocket restores filtering.

behaviors.description: Execute metadata command, forward arguments and select runtime command.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A app contains probe; runtime contains ldconfig.
behaviors.expected: Exact A output, exact argument lines, distinct ldconfig output, and app/runtime file visibility.

behaviors.description: Override and unset metadata environment.
behaviors.preconditions: A metadata sets BLACKBOX_META=metadata.
behaviors.expected: Metadata control, exact CLI replacement including equals/spaces, and unset variable absent.

behaviors.description: Clear inherited environment while retaining explicit values.
behaviors.preconditions: Controlled ordinary host variable.
behaviors.expected: Variable inherited normally, absent with clear-env, explicit value retained.

behaviors.description: Persist, show, replace, unset and reset application environment overrides.
behaviors.preconditions: A metadata environment and isolated user installation.
behaviors.expected: Public stored value and repeated run values match; run wins; unset removes; reset restores metadata.

behaviors.description: Observe global and app-specific override precedence.
behaviors.preconditions: Isolated user installation with metadata environment.
behaviors.expected: Global value, app value, restored global value, restored metadata value.

behaviors.description: Enforce absent, read-only and read-write host filesystem grants.
behaviors.preconditions: Host marker outside default grants.
behaviors.expected: Ungrant read fails; ro read succeeds and write fails without host change; rw changes host bytes.

behaviors.description: Create a granted host directory.
behaviors.preconditions: Requested host directory absent.
behaviors.expected: Probe writes exact content into newly created host directory.

behaviors.description: Revoke metadata and stored filesystem grants per run.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent host markers available through separate metadata-only and override-only grants.
behaviors.expected: Both readable controls become denied under host:reset and readable again on ordinary runs; stored deny/ro/rw/reset effects also checked.

behaviors.description: Run in requested sandbox working directory.
behaviors.preconditions: Granted host directory contains marker.
behaviors.expected: Relative read resolves exact marker bytes.

behaviors.description: Persist a home-relative directory through run and override permissions.
behaviors.preconditions: Unshared isolated home.
behaviors.expected: Bytes survive separate runs and stored permission; host home-relative marker is absent.

behaviors.description: Preserve writable application var data.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed A app.
behaviors.expected: Exact /var/data marker survives a later run.

behaviors.description: Share and revoke host network namespace with run and stored overrides.
behaviors.preconditions: Local TCP listener on loopback and no metadata network grant.
behaviors.expected: Default connect fails, run/stored share connect and accept, run/stored unshare fail in probe.

behaviors.description: Evaluate conditional network sharing.
behaviors.preconditions: Local loopback TCP server and conditional permissions support.
behaviors.expected: True condition connects and is accepted; false condition fails in probe.

behaviors.description: Expose and revoke a controlled Wayland socket path.
behaviors.preconditions: Bound dummy Unix socket selected through WAYLAND_DISPLAY.
behaviors.expected: Path absent by default, present with run/stored grant, absent with run/stored denial.

behaviors.description: Expose and revoke a controlled SSH authentication socket path.
behaviors.preconditions: Bound dummy Unix socket selected through SSH_AUTH_SOCK.
behaviors.expected: Path absent by default, present with run/stored grant, absent with run/stored denial.

behaviors.description: Evaluate conditional Wayland socket exposure.
behaviors.preconditions: Bound dummy Wayland socket and conditional permission support.
behaviors.expected: Socket visible only with true condition.

behaviors.description: Persist session and system bus name policies.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh app overrides.
behaviors.expected: Public override show has exact own/talk policies and subsequent explicit denials.

behaviors.description: Report selected session and system bus policies inside the sandbox.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed A app.
behaviors.expected: Public /.flatpak-info contains exact selected own/talk name policies.

behaviors.description: Persist explicit namespace, device and feature permission values.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh app overrides.
behaviors.expected: Public show grants ipc/dri/devel and explicitly denies network/kvm/multiarch.

behaviors.description: Report effective namespace, device and feature permission values.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed A app.
behaviors.expected: Public /.flatpak-info reports exactly ipc/dri/devel without denied network/kvm/multiarch.

behaviors.description: Select architecture, branch and runtime version.
behaviors.preconditions: A app and runtime on nondefault test branch.
behaviors.expected: Selected app executes; absent branch/runtime rejected; runtime-version overrides missing runtime tuple version.

behaviors.description: Enumerate and kill a running instance.
behaviors.preconditions: Probe holds a background application process.
behaviors.expected: Selected ps columns identify app and live process IDs; kill stops instance and removes ps row.

behaviors.description: Enter running instance with its environment and argument forwarding.
behaviors.preconditions: Probe holds background app with distinct environment value.
behaviors.expected: Entered probe sees app variable and exact arguments; instance cleaned through kill.

behaviors.description: Grant and revoke host shared-memory device access.
behaviors.preconditions: Controlled /dev/shm host marker.
behaviors.expected: Marker readable only under run/stored shm grants, absent after respective revocations.

behaviors.description: Select runnable app branch and its public desktop export.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A/B branch commits with distinct desktop names and probe output.
behaviors.expected: Both branch selections change unqualified run output and public exported desktop name.
